title: What to know about this year’s UN climate talks
summary: It’s that time of year again: Thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists are gathered for the annual UN climate talks, taking place this time in Antalya, Turkey. COP31 officially kicked off on November 8, marking the beginning of negotiations on one of the biggest stages of the climate world. Turkey and Australia are cohosting this…
llm_summary: The 31st UN climate conference (COP31) launched on Nov 8 in Antalya, Turkey—co‑hosted by Turkey and Australia—bringing together thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists to negotiate the next round of global climate commitments. Expect intense talks on tightening emissions targets, financing the transition to clean energy, and how new technologies (from renewable grids to carbon‑capture solutions) can help meet the Paris Agreement goals.
